SELECT r->>'state' AS state, r->>'coverage_started_at' AS coverage_started_at, r->>'available_from' AS available_from, r->>'requested_from' AS requested_from, r->>'report_at' AS report_at, r->>'coverage_limited' AS coverage_limited FROM (SELECT goaletto_operator.report('entry',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,jsonb_build_object('source',${source:sqlstring},'locale',${locale:sqlstring},'variant',${variant:sqlstring},'tier',${tier:sqlstring},'set',${set:sqlstring})) AS r) s

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('entry',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,jsonb_build_object('source',${source:sqlstring},'locale',${locale:sqlstring},'variant',${variant:sqlstring},'tier',${tier:sqlstring},'set',${set:sqlstring}))->'rows') AS r(starts bigint, eligible bigint, waiting bigint, claimed bigint, ready bigint, unknown_claimed_late bigint, unknown_ready_late bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('sources',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,jsonb_build_object('source',${source:sqlstring},'locale',${locale:sqlstring},'variant',${variant:sqlstring},'tier',${tier:sqlstring},'set',${set:sqlstring}))->'rows') AS r(kind text, campaign_id text, source text, placement text, published_on date, starts bigint, eligible bigint, waiting bigint, claimed bigint, ready bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('retention',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,jsonb_build_object('source',${source:sqlstring},'locale',${locale:sqlstring},'variant',${variant:sqlstring},'tier',${tier:sqlstring},'set',${set:sqlstring}))->'rows') AS r(day integer, starts bigint, eligible bigint, waiting bigint, retained bigint, unknown_late bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('opportunities',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,jsonb_build_object('source',${source:sqlstring},'locale',${locale:sqlstring},'variant',${variant:sqlstring},'tier',${tier:sqlstring},'set',${set:sqlstring}))->'rows') AS r(stage text, state text, managers bigint, participated_n bigint, unknown_late bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('last_steps',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,jsonb_build_object('source',${source:sqlstring},'locale',${locale:sqlstring},'variant',${variant:sqlstring},'tier',${tier:sqlstring},'set',${set:sqlstring}))->'rows') AS r(source_kind text, campaign_id text, locale text, cohort_week date, entry_path text, last_step text, surface text, managers bigint, offers_accepted bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('recovery',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,jsonb_build_object('source',${source:sqlstring},'locale',${locale:sqlstring},'variant',${variant:sqlstring},'tier',${tier:sqlstring},'set',${set:sqlstring}))->'rows') AS r(reason text, surface text, target text, errors bigint, managers bigint, "eligible_N" bigint, waiting bigint, help_accepted bigint, help_unconfirmed bigint, recovered_n bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('queues',now()-interval '1 hour',now(),'{}'::jsonb)->'rows') AS r(queue text, status text, items bigint, due_items bigint, oldest_due_seconds double precision)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('worker',now()-interval '1 hour',now(),'{}'::jsonb)->'rows') AS r(component text, outcome text, state text, started_at timestamptz, observed_at timestamptz, succeeded_at timestamptz, observation_age_seconds double precision, success_age_seconds double precision)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('latency',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'{}'::jsonb)->'rows') AS r(metric text, observations bigint, measured bigint, unknown bigint, p50_seconds double precision, p95_seconds double precision)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('delivery',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'{}'::jsonb)->'rows') AS r(kind text, total bigint, delivered bigint, failed_known bigint, failed_unknown bigint, pending bigint, unknown_messages bigint)
SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('delivery_attempts',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'{}'::jsonb)->'rows') AS r(outcome text, count bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('feedback',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'{}'::jsonb)->'rows') AS r(campaign text, internal boolean, "offered_N" bigint, delivery_confirmed bigint, delivery_unconfirmed bigint, answered_n bigint, skipped_n bigint, opted_out_n bigint, redacted_unknown bigint, expired_unanswered bigint, waiting bigint)

SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(goaletto_operator.report('feedback_reasons',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz,$__timeTo()::timestamptz,'{}'::jsonb)->'rows') AS r(campaign text, internal boolean, reason text, answers bigint)
